written_after: Experiment 9 Attempt 1 failed the frozen G32 control-reproduction gate (HotpotQA F1 57.7 vs canonical 55.2, tolerance +/-1.0); see failed_attempt_1/attempt_record.json, archived at 239a4bd70587f7b52d8c1258fe62faf88d64b45b
statement: This amendment was written AFTER Attempt 1 failed. It was NOT part of the pre-registered protocol and is not presented as such.

authorization.scope: one full, fresh re-execution of the entire frozen Experiment 9 sweep (bf16, G16, G32, G64) on ALL five benchmarks from the beginning, in the frozen order: continuation_ppl, niah, passage_retrieval, hotpotqa, qasper
authorization.selective_rerun_prohibited: a HotpotQA-only (or any partial / selective) rerun is prohibited
authorization.validity_rule: the exact original gates, including G32 control reproduction within the ORIGINAL tolerances (PPL +/-0.5% relative; accuracy / F1 +/-1.0 point; logical KV MB +/-0.1% relative), storage matching the frozen expected values, exact counts, no parser / config drift, prior evidence unchanged
authorization.if_attempt_2_fails_any_gate: archive it and STOP: no third run, no tolerance change, no selective benchmark rerun

no_cross_attempt_pooling: no raw sample, per-example score or benchmark result is pooled, substituted or combined across attempts; Attempt 1 values are never used to rescue or supplement Attempt 2
reason: The canonical control failed because one stochastic generated answer changed, while configuration, storage accounting, the bf16 control and 19/20 HotpotQA sample scores reproduced. The frozen evaluation methodology (TF32 enabled, no deterministic algorithms, fresh H100 instances) is known to allow non-bit-exact generation across fresh runs; the observed change is consistent with that, not a proven causal diagnosis.
